description: Run a software project end-to-end: stand up and operate a GitHub Project (v2) board (setup, weekly triage, status reporting, dependency sequencing), turn intent into conformant issues and source-grounded plans, keep sessions continuous via a durable handoff, and produce project docs — CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, value-and-proof READMEs, diagrams, and status comms. name: project-workflow
